title: Meta Just Opened an 816B Model
content:
[TITLE: Meta Just Opened an 816B Model]

[HOOK: Meta blog headline on screen]
Meta just released an 816 BILLION parameter model...
and you can download it for FREE.

[GRAPHIC: 816B total / 42B active / 1M context | Source: research.meta.ai]
It's called MUSE SPARK OPEN.
816 billion parameters in total...
but only 42 BILLION are active for each token.
And the context window?
1 MILLION tokens.

[CAM: close-up]
So what does that mean in simple words?
The model is HUGE...
but it runs at the speed of a much smaller model.
Why? Because it's a mixture of experts.
For every token, only a few "experts" do the work.
The rest just sit and wait.

[B-ROLL: node diagram lighting up]
Big brain. Small-model speed.

[SCREEN: Hugging Face model page | Source: huggingface.co/meta-models]
Meta says it's built for coding and AGENTS.
And the weights are already up on Hugging Face.

[CAM: face]
Now, the builder's angle.
One million tokens of context means...
you can drop in a WHOLE codebase...
or an entire set of documents... in a single prompt.
No chopping things into pieces.
No losing track of what the model saw earlier.
For agents that work on real projects, that's a big deal.

[SCREEN: license section | Source: Muse Model License]
But read the license before you get excited.
Big companies need a SEPARATE agreement with Meta.
And here's the catch most people miss.
Even though only 42 billion are active...
all 816 billion have to sit in memory.
So you need SERIOUS hardware to run this yourself.
Your laptop is not going to cut it.

[CAM: face]
So what's my plan?
I'm going to test it on a hosted API.
And I'll share the results in the next reel.

[CTA]
FOLLOW for daily AI...
explained by a builder.
